description: A work OS and project management platform that lets teams build custom workflows, track projects, and connect AI agents.
auth_notes: Supports personal V2 API tokens passed via the Authorization header, app tokens with permission scopes, and OAuth2 for public/private apps.
credential_notes: Developers can sign up for a free account or free developer sandbox/account to generate a personal API token directly in the Developer Center.
api_notes: An expressive GraphQL API covering boards, groups, items, workspaces, updates, webhooks, workflows, and management of agents and MCP tools.
mcp_notes: Official vendor-published Model Context Protocol (MCP) server available via mondaycom/mcp on GitHub and integrated hosted endpoints.
rationale: Monday.com provides a broad GraphQL API, self-serve free developer credentials, and an official MCP server, making it fully ready for AI agent integration today.

evidence.note: Explains personal V2 API tokens and app tokens passed in the Authorization header.
States that users can create a free developer account to get an API token and start testing.
Describes the expressive GraphQL Platform API covering boards, items, workspaces, and workflows.
Lists the official mondaycom/mcp repository published by monday.com.
